note: Girder's adapter onto the material library (core/materials/PLAN.md). Per FAMMAT family: the library set, its tile size in world metres, how much of the set's own colour survives Girder's palette tint (keep 0 = grey detail coloured by the instance or vertex colour), the roughness lift, metal. Families not listed keep their procedural TEX.def map: leafy, web, bark1 (ghostwood), bark2 (prism gum), glowmat. Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py settlements/girder after any change, then python3 build.py. tint.mean is the mean brightness of the family's procedural map (measured 2026-10-03), so a library set keeps the brightness Girder's palette and lights were tuned on. specular is Godot's StandardMaterial3D specular (0.5 = physical default); lower keeps the palette from washing grey at grazing angles under the sun. tint.contrast deepens a set that reads flat from a distance (the bark of 60-100 m trunks).
